$comment: QA Accounts (CONTEXT.md). Public by design: `yarn qa:accounts:seed` creates them and refuses any database that is not local. Each account's sign-in password, Vault passphrase and key material are derived from its id by tools/scripts/lib/qa-accounts.ts and are not written here; `yarn qa:accounts` prints them. `platformAdmin: true` marks the one Platform Admin QA Account: the seeder does not promote it, the QA stack points the backend's PLATFORM_ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_EMAIL at it (tools/qa/lib/qa-stack.ts). See docs/adr/0122-a-qa-accounts-credentials-are-public-fixtures-in-tracked-source.md.
